name: bk-mod-context
description: Full-width context meter above the prompt: real token fill from the API, a green-to-red heat bar with a glowing leading edge, and the model and effort beside it.

greenUntil.title: Green until
greenUntil.description: Tokens of context that stay green; past it the bar heats through yellow and orange to red at the full window. On a window smaller than 2.5 times this, 40% of the window is used instead.

animation.title: Animation
animation.description: full: the leading edge flickers, its pulse licks forward, and each advance leaves a trail of embers that catches up within a second. calm: the same, slower. off: a still bar.
